input: Original PDF bytes through readNativePdfSource; never caller-provided geometry
meaning: Literal source roles and physical ownership only; no numeric conversion, money comparison, matching or financial approval
title: Inventory carrying-value register
reportIdentity: Nonempty first-page Report ID of at most 255 characters; repeated exactly on every page. No hardcoded fixture ID, currency, date or entity.
pages: Each physical page must provide Page N of actual total. All pages, source tokens, unresolved lines and original hash are retained.
scope: First page provides all twelve distinct scope labels; later pages repeat at least Currency and As of and may repeat other fields consistently. Missing fields are not inferred from transaction extremes.
tables: Seven explicit field roles in any physical order for flat rows, or six roles under explicit Warehouse and Batch headers; positions and local header ownership define field intervals. No global document cuts.
dimensions: New Warehouse clears Batch and header. Boundaries are End section, next Warehouse, Page total or explicit outgoing continuation. No dimension is inherited from a preceding section/page alone.
continuation: Explicit outgoing and incoming key, same report, correct physical page sequence, locally repeated Warehouse and Batch and table roles. A continuation applies only to its own section.
evidence: Each role, value, parent, batch, boundary, scope and control cites original hash, physical page/line, exact native item IDs, text and box.
readingIssues: Any G1 display warning blocks G2 interpretation; retains complete source and unresolved inventory. This does not establish partial financial isolation.
failure: Keep native source, all token inventory and interpreted raw records plus precise first structural error. Status source-error never authorizes accounting use.

deferredG3.INV1F-N09: G2 must preserve the wrong page-total literal and interpret roles; G3 must reject PAGE_TOTAL
deferredG3.INV1F-N12: G2 must preserve precision 1 and quantity 1.250 without rounding; G3 must reject PRECISION

budget: Nineteen unchanged frozen PDFs, two layout families, four positive presentations and one known financial story; 29 units including two bounded collision/gap probes, nine checker faults and eight code mutations.
excluded: enterprise capacity or field accuracy claims
textAuthority: Span text is display assembly. Native items and measured gaps are retained. gap-presentation does not prove whitespace count or canonical financial identity; G3 must prove literal identity from original glyph evidence or keep it unresolved, never normalize it silently.
